name: wizard
description: Generate an interactive bash wizard script that walks a human step by step through procedures only a human can perform—provisioning infrastructure, setting credentials or CI secrets, navigating third-party dashboards, or running one-off migrations and cutovers—built on a consistent reusable bash library with hidden secret entry, idempotent .env upserts, and safe y/N confirmation gates.
suggestedPrompts: Generate an interactive bash wizard to configure third-party credentials and CI secrets for this repo
Build a step-by-step bash runbook wizard for this one-off production cutover
Create a repeatable onboarding setup wizard for our .env and GitHub Actions secrets
